metadata.question: Does location (33.97811334086217, -118.2436826460509) at Los Angeles have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than location (32.7358717958782,-117.15380986802357) San Diego from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for NO2 data - Date range: 2018-2019 - Locations: Point at Los Angeles (33.978, -118.244) and Point at San Diego (32.736, -117.154) - TROPOMI provides global NO2 concentration data at ~5.5km resolution 2. Masking strategy: - NO2 data from Sentinel-5P is already processed and quality-filtered - Use QA values to filter valid measurements - No cloud masking needed for this product (already handled in L2 processing) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Compare average NO2 concentrations between two locations - Check pixel counts to ensure data exists (avoid C2) - Validate results are within reasonable NO2 ranges (0-500 µmol/m²) - If calculation returns None or out-of-range values → C3 - If comparison yields a valid result → A (higher) or B (not higher) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define locations la_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217]) sd_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782]) # 2. Time period start_date = '2018-01-01' end_date = '2019-12-31' # 3. Load Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .select('NO2_column_number_density') # Check collection size col_size = col.size().getInfo() print(f"TROPOMI NO2 images available: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No TROPOMI data found for 2018-2019.") print("C1") else: # 4. Filter valid quality data (QA >= 0.5) col_qa = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) def mask_qa(image): qa = image.select('qa_value') masked = image.select('NO2_column_number_density').updateMask(qa.gte(0.5)) return masked col_masked = col_qa.map(mask_qa) # 5. Calculate mean NO2 for LA la_mean = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).sample( geometry=la_point, scale=11000 ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo() la_count = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.count()).sample( geometry=la_point, scale=11000 ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo() # 6. Calculate mean NO2 for SD sd_mean = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).sample( geometry=sd_point, scale=11000 ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo() sd_count = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.count()).sample( geometry=sd_point, scale=11000 ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo() print(f"LA: Mean NO2={la_mean:.4f} µmol/m² (samples: {la_count})") print(f"SD: Mean NO2={sd_mean:.4f} µmol/m² (samples: {sd_count})") # 7. Validation if la_mean is None or sd_mean is None: print("C3") elif la_count == 0 or sd_count == 0: print("C2") elif la_mean > sd_mean: print(f"LA ({la_mean:.4f}) > SD ({sd_mean:.4f}): YES") print("A") else: print(f"LA ({la_mean:.4f}) <= SD ({sd_mean:.4f}): NO") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define locations
la_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217])
sd_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782])

# 2. Time period
start_date = '2018-01-01'
end_date = '2019-12-31'

# 3. Load Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data
col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .select('NO2_column_number_density')

# Check collection size
col_size = col.size().getInfo()
print(f"TROPOMI NO2 images available: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No TROPOMI data found for 2018-2019.")
    print("C1")
else:
    # 4. Filter valid quality data (QA >= 0.5)
    col_qa = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date)
    
    def mask_qa(image):
        qa = image.select('qa_value')
        masked = image.select('NO2_column_number_density').updateMask(qa.gte(0.5))
        return masked
    
    col_masked = col_qa.map(mask_qa)
    
    # 5. Calculate mean NO2 for LA
    la_mean = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).sample(
        geometry=la_point, scale=11000
    ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo()
    
    la_count = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.count()).sample(
        geometry=la_point, scale=11000
    ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo()
    
    # 6. Calculate mean NO2 for SD
    sd_mean = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).sample(
        geometry=sd_point, scale=11000
    ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo()
    
    sd_count = col_masked.reduce(ee.Reducer.count()).sample(
        geometry=sd_point, scale=11000
    ).first().get('NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo()
    
    print(f"LA: Mean NO2={la_mean:.4f} µmol/m² (samples: {la_count})")
    print(f"SD: Mean NO2={sd_mean:.4f} µmol/m² (samples: {sd_count})")
    
    # 7. Validation
    if la_mean is None or sd_mean is None:
        print("C3")
    elif la_count == 0 or sd_count == 0:
        print("C2")
    elif la_mean > sd_mean:
        print(f"LA ({la_mean:.4f}) > SD ({sd_mean:.4f}): YES")
        print("A")
    else:
        print(f"LA ({la_mean:.4f}) <= SD ({sd_mean:.4f}): NO")
        print("B")
